aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: All primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The config_prompt_to_main dependency is the primary signal because top-level workflow behavior is sensitive to stale context, prompt, and replay contracts.
The source_to_main dependency captures stale assumptions around local path, URL, VCS, zip, cache reuse, and cleanup behavior.
The generate_hooks_to_main dependency captures stale assumptions around project directory creation, hook failure cleanup, and generation exceptions.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Configuration, replay, and prompt code must provide stable context shape, default merging, no_input, choices, and extra_context behavior consumed by the top-level workflow.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when config/context/prompt probes and main workflow context preservation probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The orchestration agent may preserve, replay, or pass context using stale assumptions about config defaults, extra_context overwrites, choices, or no_input prompt behavior.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Repository, VCS, and zipfile source resolution must return stable repo_dir, cleanup, URL/archive classification, and cache reuse semantics consumed by cookiecutter().
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when source resolution probes and top-level workflow probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The orchestration agent may use stale assumptions about whether a source path must be cloned, unzipped, reused, prompted for deletion, or cleaned up.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Generation and hooks must provide stable project directory creation, overwrite/skip behavior, hook execution, failure cleanup, and undefined-variable semantics consumed by the workflow.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when template discovery, file generation, hook execution, and main workflow probes pass together.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The orchestration agent may call generation or cleanup code using stale assumptions about generated project paths, hook failure behavior, overwrite flags, or undefined-variable exceptions.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves Cookiecutter config/prompt, source resolution, generation/hook, and main workflow contracts.
